name: slow_pad
prompt: Turn this into a slow, soft pad: gentle fade in and a long release.

name: pluck
prompt: Make it a short pluck: instant attack, quick decay, no sustain.

name: reverb
prompt: Put it in a big hall.

name: darker
prompt: Make it darker with filter 1, closed well below the default.

name: wobble
prompt: Use LFO 1 to wobble filter 1's cutoff.

name: supersaw
prompt: Make oscillator 1 a thick detuned supersaw with lots of unison voices.

name: octave_up
prompt: Transpose oscillator 1 up one octave.

name: mono_glide
prompt: Make it a monophonic lead that glides between notes.

name: pump
prompt: Use LFO 1 to make the volume pump in time with the tempo.

name: custom_lfo
prompt: Draw a falling ramp on LFO 2 and use it to modulate oscillator 1's level.

name: hollow_wavetable
prompt: Give oscillator 1 a new hollow timbre made of odd harmonics only.

name: wavetable_sweep
prompt: Have envelope 2 sweep through oscillator 1's wave frames on every note.

name: chorus
prompt: Widen it with some chorus.

name: delay
prompt: Add an echo.

name: grit
prompt: Add some distortion for grit.

name: fifth
prompt: Turn on oscillator 2 a perfect fifth above oscillator 1.

name: quieter
prompt: Bring the master volume down to about -15 dB.

name: velocity_brightness
prompt: Turn on filter 1 and make harder key presses open its cutoff.

name: vibrato
prompt: Add vibrato controlled by the mod wheel.

name: macro_space
prompt: Make macro 1 control how much reverb there is.

name: louder_asks_first
prompt: Make it much louder, +5 dB on the master.
